mode: source-only, read-only, no execution or imports

findings.summary: _row_alive requires gameplay_frames == alive_frames + 1 for every row; valid truncated cap rows have alive == gameplay == 18000.
findings.trigger: Any ranking candidate with >=1 truncated episode at the 18000-frame cap.
findings.consequence: produce_selection raises ValueError and writes no selection record. Fail-closed availability block; no wrong winner.
findings.fix: Branch _row_alive on terminated/truncated; add truncated accept/reject and end-to-end cap-row tests.

findings.summary: Selection record omits summary and outer-receipt path/sha; validate_selection_record cannot replay postflight proof.
findings.trigger: Hand-written or non-producer record plus six valid result files where ranking postflight failed.
findings.consequence: Validator accepts a record the producer would refuse. Exposure limited while producer is sole writer.
findings.fix: Record and validator carry/pin outer receipt and summary bindings; re-run producer's identity/postflight/artifact checks.

findings.summary: Confirmation worker validate_selection does not call validate_selection_record and does not recompute argmax; R4 H-1 remains open at the worker.
findings.trigger: Selection record with non-argmax winner, matching pins and six valid refs.
findings.consequence: Worker accepts it until the parent-reviewed contract revision wires the validator with externally pinned result bindings.
findings.fix: Parent-reviewed revision to worker call site. Not part of this producer.

findings.summary: Fixtures diverge from evaluator row shape: startup_frames 0 (evaluator 13); terminated rows lack fatal_gameplay_frame and death_observed_lethal_contacts.
findings.consequence: Suite cannot catch H-1 and claims shape fidelity it does not have.

findings.summary: _row_alive checks a subset of _validate_rows: no startup_frames==13, no score_delta_sum check, no alive<=gameplay<=cap bound, no death/cap telemetry rules, loose numeric type on gameplay_frames.
findings.trigger: Evaluator regression producing rows the producer should reject.
findings.consequence: Producer accepts inconsistent rows; winner-by-alive impact limited.
findings.fix: Mirror evaluator rules with one test per rule.

findings.summary: Selection record written directly with open('x'); crash leaves partial file.
findings.consequence: Re-run fails with FileExistsError (fail closed); manual cleanup.
findings.fix: Temp file in same dir, fsync, then exclusive rename/link.
